title: A Terminal for the Orbit
author: Ada Thornbury
blurb: Casper Blackwood, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
